label: D2 after choosing a2, when the previous trial was rewarded (first ~60 trials of the episode)
explanation: Fires almost only at D2 (99.3% of mass; a few weak GO hits), and only when this trial's choice was a2 (in_action == 2 at D2; zero activations after a1 choices). Within that it needs the previous trial to have been rewarded (prev_reward == 1 holds 96% of mass) and it switches off over the episode: highest in trials 10-50, fading by trial 60-69, and silent after trial ~70, so ep_trial < 60 is a proxy for some slowly drifting hidden state, not an observed input. Magnitude is largest when a2 led to the rare state S1 (S1R cells reach ~0.85-1.0 of max, compared with ~0.4-0.6 for S2 common); restricting to state == 1 gives precision 0.83 but only 0.45 mass recall. Adding prev_action != 1 (stay on a2) raised dev F1 slightly (0.78 vs 0.77); I kept the simpler form. Never fires at D1, after a1, or after an unrewarded previous trial (except rarely). Dev: P 0.68, R 0.88, F1 0.77, mass recall 0.94. Precision is incomplete: many a2-rewarded D2 steps in early episodes stay silent, partly in high_first episodes and when S1 is good. All variables are observed at D2.
